subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493 DR.
source_quote: 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: derro count
fact: Many Derro are present in their enclaves, with deep and defensible tunnels.
source_quote: how many Derro there are, how defensible their enclaves are, and how deep the tunnels go

subject: feywild banishment
fact: The banishment of the Drow occurred in the Feywild, and from the Underdark in the Feywild, the Drow fled to every part of the multiverse.
source_quote: the banishment occurred in the Feywild, and from the Underdark in the Feywild, the Drow fled to every part of the multiverse

subject: noble house destruction
fact: A noble house will try to destroy another house, and if it fails, then the other noble houses will ruin it.
source_quote: a noble house will try to destroy another house. And if it fails, then the other noble houses will ruin it

subject: grey ghosts alliance
fact: The Grey Ghosts and the Council of Savants are suspected of working together, but proximity does not imply collaboration.
source_quote: I knew the Grey Ghosts and the Council were working together! ... People being near each other doesn’t mean working together on everything

subject: overlake hold
fact: Errde's chambers are located at Overlake Hold, where trauma dumps and political manipulation occur.
source_quote: followed the group to Overlake Hold to talk to Errde

subject: duergar war
fact: The Duergar may not win the war against the Derro due to the defensibility of Derro enclaves and depth of tunnels.
source_quote: I am not so sure that the Duergar will win this war

subject: shattered spire tavern
fact: The Shattered Spire is a tavern built on a broken stalagmite forty feet from the Darklake shore, accessed by a rothé wool bridge.
source_quote: The Shattered Spire, where the merchant Werz insisted they meet. It is built on a broken stalagmite that juts out from the Darklake about forty feet from the shore. This stalagmite forms the foundation of a tavern built with fungi stalks in a manner similar to a log cabin. Grygum has to cross a bridge woven of rothé wool to get to it.

subject: gemstone value
fact: Werz gives each companion a gemstone worth 10 gold pieces.
source_quote: hands Grygum and each of his companions a gemstone worth 10 gold pieces

subject: nda negotiation
fact: Daz negotiates a Non-Disclosure Agreement with Werz at 1000 gold pieces, down from 1250, with threats of escalation.
source_quote: 1250 gold is our normal NDA price... we would be willing to go down to a flat 1000... If you question it again, it goes to 1100... 1100

subject: clan ironhead
fact: Clan Ironhead is forbidden from taking weapons directly and may only take surplus orders from Clan Steelshadow, causing resentment.
source_quote: Clan Ironhead is forbidden from taking weapons directly and may only take surplus orders from Clan Steelshadow. The Deepking has been sending all orders to his clan, Clan Steelshadow. Clan Ironhead is upset with the loss of business.

subject: clan xardelva
fact: Clan Xardelva is worried their work will be seen as too similar to weaponsmithing and that Clan Steelshadow will take them over.
source_quote: Clan Xardelva, they are worried that their work will be seen as too similar to weaponsmithing, and Clan Steelshadow will take them over.

subject: assassin rumor
fact: Werz claims he was targeted by assassins, but Grygum suspects he hired them and now fears retaliation.
source_quote: Assassins! I thought they were a story told to frighten children... I guess that would get me into trouble with any actual Assassin’s Guild... Maybe he ordered somebody to assassinate somebody, and now somebody else found out and they have ordered somebody to assassinate him

subject: clan tharzgad
fact: Clan Tharzgad has been complaining about raids by the Grey Ghosts.
source_quote: Clan Tharzgad has been complaining about raids by the Grey Ghosts.

subject: clan xundom
fact: Clan Xundom will support the Deepking if war breaks out.
source_quote: some, like Clan Xundom, will support the Deepking if war breaks out.

subject: stone guard bribery
fact: Rumors suggest the Stone Guards have become corrupt, taking bribes since the Deepking’s madness took hold.
source_quote: There are rumors of the Stone Guards taking bribes... They were until a few months ago when the madness of the Deepking took over.

subject: blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone is the target of merchant Werz’s proposed weapon deals with the Drow clans.
source_quote: you are looking to get to Blingdenstone. The gnomes have been trying to make deals with the clans for weapons. I can help facilitate such a deal.

subject: ghost haunting
fact: Daz offers only the haunting of a ghost as penalty for breaching secrecy, not the horrific outcomes typical of Drow NDAs.
source_quote: We can only promise the haunting of a ghost.

subject: flumph gem behavior
fact: The Flumph interacts with a gemstone, turning light blue, then green (picking it up), then magenta (dropping it).
source_quote: the Flumph turns light blue. Then, when it turns green, it picks the stone up and plays with it in its tentacles. After a while, it turns magenta, and the stone falls to the ground.

subject: gholbrorn’s inn
fact: Werz has already spoken to the owner of Gholbrorn’s Inn and will take care of arrangements.
source_quote: I have already spoken to the owner of the Gholbrorn’s Inn, and I will take care of everything.

subject: duergar deviation
fact: The Duergar's deviation from Drow norms makes their city more perilous, as conflict here is protracted rather than swift.
source_quote: Daz understands that societal norms differ, and the Duergar's deviation from Drow norms makes their city more perilous. Unlike the Drow's swift executions, conflict here is protracted.

subject: drow power desire
fact: Daz observes that Drow leaders are not victims of outside influence, but are blinded by their own desire for power and fear of confronting the true ruler.
source_quote: everyone convinced that the leader is a victim of some outside influence, and a need to destroy the outside influence. No one wants to confront the reality that they want power, and they are too afraid of the leader to try and seize it from them.

subject: radical transparency
fact: Thorin rejects subterfuge and advocates radical transparency, inspired by his giant tribe’s directness.
source_quote: He wants to be radically transparent, to say it as it is. He liked his giant tribe; they didn’t invent complex plots and plans. They were direct and to the point.

subject: discretion over confrontation
fact: Zalthir was trained to avoid frontal conflict and values discretion, hiding in shadows, and running.
source_quote: The monks who taught Zalthir the importance of being discreet, of hiding in the shadows, and of avoiding frontal conflict. He sees no upside to doing anything but running.

subject: clan steelshadow dominance
fact: Clan Steelshadow holds exclusive control over weapon orders from the Deepking, causing resentment among other clans.
source_quote: The Deepking has been sending all orders to his clan, Clan Steelshadow.

subject: deepking corruption
fact: Daz believes the Deepking is being manipulated, not corrupting others, and that the Council of Savants are victims, not villains.
source_quote: The idea that they have so much control over the Deepking makes Daz laugh... They are victims of the machinations of yet another power.

subject: drow survival philosophy
fact: For the Drow, you either exterminate your enemy or don’t try — hesitation is fatal.
source_quote: For the Drow, you either exterminate your enemy or don’t try.

subject: lurking threat
fact: Daz warns that providing the wrong information to the wrong group can trigger all-out war.
source_quote: Provide the wrong faction with the wrong information, and you will have all-out war.

subject: ghost threat
fact: Daz uses the threat of a haunting ghost as the only consequence for breaking secrecy — a weak deterrent compared to Drow norms.
source_quote: We can only promise the haunting of a ghost.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493 DR.
source_quote: 1st day of the 2nd Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: travel to Underlake Hold
fact: Jimjar, Spiderbait, Sarith, and Eldeth walk to the Underlake Hold, where Errde arms them.
source_quote: Jimjar, Spiderbait, Sarith, and Eldeth walk to the Underlake Hold, where Errde arms them.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: Whorlstone Tunnels
fact: They will have to go into the Whorlstone Tunnels and find the evidence for at least one of the many different factions.
source_quote: Whorlstone Tunnels

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: travel to Clan Ironhead
fact: The entire group heads to Clan Ironhead and asks to speak with the clan leader.
source_quote: The entire group heads to Clan Ironhead and asks to speak with the clan leader.

subject: Gnomish city
fact: The Deepking has imposed exorbitant pricing upon the Deep Gnomes.
source_quote: the gnomish city

subject: discount negotiation
fact: Clan Ironhead would willingly extend a discounted rate relative to their standard tariffs.
source_quote: we would willingly extend a discounted rate relative to our standard tariffs.

subject: quagoth count
fact: Quagoths are bad, mean creatures. The quagoth attacked, and those Myconids had to kill him.
source_quote: Quagoths are bad, mean creatures. The quagoth attacked, and those Myconids had to kill him.

subject: save Rumpadump
fact: We have to save him! Because he’s from my circle. And the dancing Myconids must be from our circle.
source_quote: Because he’s from my circle. And the dancing Myconids must be from our circle.

subject: Ghohlbrorn’s Lair
fact: The rest of the crew sits at a table in the Ghohlbrorn’s Lair.
source_quote: Ghohlbrorn’s Lair

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: There is an alchemist in Blingdenstone who can turn these gems into gems of immense magical power.
source_quote: Blingdenstone

subject: payment offer
fact: Kazook Pickshine will pay a lot for them.
source_quote: Kazook Pickshine, he will pay a lot for them.

subject: deal with assassins
fact: We can do it after we deal with the assassins?
source_quote: We can do it after we deal with the assassins?

subject: free Thermbachaude
fact: And free Thermbachaude.
source_quote: And free Thermbachaude.

subject: Duergar Brannam’s arrival
fact: The Duergar Brannam shows up with the magical weapons and items Thorin and Zalthir requested.
source_quote: The Duergar Brannam shows up with the magical weapons and items Thorin and Zalthir requested.

subject: tattoo value
fact: Zalthir sews the tattoos on his body. He thinks that perhaps now he won’t die.
source_quote: Zalthir sews the tattoos on his body. He thinks that perhaps now he won’t die.

subject: fee for getting rid of assassins
fact: We didn’t discuss the fee for getting rid of the assassins.
source_quote: We didn’t discuss the fee for getting rid of the assassins.

subject: 1100 gold payment
fact: You just got 1100 gold!
source_quote: You just got 1100 gold!

subject: Grinta Ironhead’s offer
fact: Grinta Ironhead offers a discount if the Deepking is deposed.
source_quote: Grinta Ironhead. I know you are trying to go to the overbrite through the city of the gnomes. The Deepking has raised prices to astronomical levels for the Deep Gnomes. Now, if the Deepking were unseated, Clan Ironhead would be free to do business with the gnomes, and we would be willing to do so at a discount of our normal prices.

subject: Drow outpost
fact: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky
